create_GaudiSeq2SeqTrainer: create a GaudiSeq2SeqTrainer instance with a model, gaudi_config, and training arguments for HPU-optimized Seq2Seq training
load_generation_config: load a GaudiGenerationConfig from a file path, directory, or model ID string using GaudiSeq2SeqTrainer.load_generation_config
evaluate_with_generation: run evaluation on a Seq2Seq model using GaudiSeq2SeqTrainer.evaluate with generation kwargs like max_length and num_beams
predict_with_generate: run predictions on a test dataset using GaudiSeq2SeqTrainer.predict with generation-specific kwargs for HPU inference
prediction_step_generate: perform a single prediction step using model.generate with HPU graphs, lazy mode, and synced GPUs via GaudiSeq2SeqTrainer.prediction_step
